title: Illumination of Scripture
definition: Illumination is the work of the Holy Spirit by which He helps believers understand, receive, and rightly respond to the truth of Scripture.
summary: The Spirit does not give a new Bible or replace careful study. He opens hearts and minds to understand God's Word, love the truth, see Christ, and obey what Scripture teaches.
christFocus: The Holy Spirit glorifies Christ by opening the Scriptures to us. Illumination helps believers see the beauty, truth, authority, and saving work of Jesus in the Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Illumination is necessary because sin darkens understanding and resists God's truth. The Spirit helps believers understand the Word spiritually, not merely intellectually.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Bible study is not merely an academic exercise. We need humility, prayer, and the Spirit's help to rightly understand and respond to God's Word.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray before, during, and after reading Scripture. Ask the Holy Spirit to reveal truth, convict sin, strengthen faith, and lead you into obedience.
